_comment: File extension (no dot, lowercase) -> console name, matching the keys in cores.json. Used to auto-detect which console a ROM belongs to from its filename alone -- for a .zip, the file INSIDE the archive is inspected instead (see detectConsoleForFile in server.js). Deliberately excludes ambiguous extensions shared by multiple consoles (.bin, .iso, .cue, .img, .chd) -- a ROM using one of those needs to sit in an explicit Emulation/<Console>/ folder instead of being auto-detected.
